object.attr: stakeholder: an enumeration is a closed list, so a misspelt value would reach the files unnoticed. Letter case is included as in MELLON-CHECK-SRS-16, so that a filter's eq finds each value the edit accepted (CF-E46, review Q47).
object.description: If an edit sets an enumeration attribute to a value that is neither empty nor exactly one of the attribute's options, letter case included, Mellon shall refuse the edit.
